Title: List of qualified players for Continental Championship (2014-2015)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The list of qualified players for Continental Championship, season 2014-2015 can be found here:

www.vekn.net/cc_qualified_2015.html

It is refreshed daily, based upon the results uploaded in the Event Calendar.

If you think you are qualified but can't find your name, it's likely that the event was never reported!

In that case, please check first on the event calendar that the tournament is properly reported. If not, contact the organizer with your National Coordinator and the Ranking Coordinator () in copy.[/quote]

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
